checklist.item: Visit https://hackenproof.com/programs/ample-smart-contracts and extract exact in-scope contract addresses, Base/Arbitrum deployments, excluded contracts, and submission rules.
Clone the official Ample repo and map all verified mainnet source files to the addresses listed in scope.
Invoke agents/deep_dive_audit.py with the Base and Arbitrum contract addresses as targets and enable full recon + static passes.
Run Slither, Aderyn, and Mythril via the tool on every in-scope contract, then triage the raw reports for false positives.
Execute Halmos symbolic execution on critical functions (transfer, mint, burn, rebase, oracle updates) using the same script.
Manually inspect access-control modifiers, proxy upgrade logic, oracle trust assumptions, and reentrancy vectors against the taxonomy.
Validate any business-logic or economic invariants specific to Ample’s rebasing token model that automated tools missed.
Produce a minimal PoC transaction sequence for each confirmed finding and record gas, block, and chain details.
Format the report per HackenProof template (severity, impact, steps-to-reproduce, fix recommendation) and submit through the platform.
